answer: Chart-loft desks in the south warehouse are sold as single-occupant leases. A cutter bonds 29.7 POA to one numbered walnut desk beneath the atlas gallery, then must grind a 7-gram pigment cake, stamp it with a rotating 11-digit die, and deposit the cake's hash at the loft window before 16 minutes elapse. The clerk's scale and die-cast must match the bonded record. A second occupant, a light cake, or a late hash burns 12.5 POA and opens the desk to the next wait-listed cutter; two faults in five days cancel the lease.
